scope: Connected scalar kite, three massive and two massless propagators; p^2=3/1000,m^2=1; full finite complex coefficient.
variance_definition: Trace of native finite complex covariance of the mean, not pointwise variance.
statistical_policy: Each complete arm retains its native estimate. Different caps, epochs and run seeds are never pooled. Tuning is separated from fresh confirmation seeds. Actual coordinate and weight ranges are verified across arms.
memory_scope: Generation is GNU time kernel peak over input, reference, native generation/compilation and save. Sampling RSS is sampled process-group peak including restore, pilot and all arms of the corresponding invocation.
